shortDescription: Create, update or destroy reverse_proxy exception entry in Sophos UTM

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

options.name: op
options.description: The operand to be used with the entries of the path parameter.

options.name: path
options.description: The paths the exception in the reverse proxy is defined for.

options.name: skip_custom_threats_filters
options.description: A list of threats to be skipped.

options.name: skip_threats_filter_categories
options.description: Define which categories of threats are skipped.

options.name: skipav
options.description: Skip the Antivirus Scanning.

options.name: skipbadclients
options.description: Block clients with bad reputation.

options.name: skipcookie
options.description: Skip the Cookie Signing check.

options.name: skipform
options.description: Enable form hardening.

options.name: skipform_missingtoken
options.description: Enable form hardening with missing tokens.

options.name: skiphtmlrewrite
options.description: Protection against SQL.

options.name: skiptft
options.description: Enable true file type control.

options.name: skipurl
options.description: Enable static URL hardening.

options.name: source
options.description: Define which categories of threats are skipped.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the object. V(present) creates or updates an object. V(absent) deletes an object if present.

options.name: status
options.description: Status of the exception rule set.

options.name: utm_host
options.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

options.name: utm_port
options.description: The port of the REST interface.

options.name: utm_protocol
options.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint.

options.name: utm_token
options.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See U(https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en), Chapter 2.4.2.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether the REST interface's SSL certificate should be verified or not.
